name: Lone dot carrier plus iris
description: A single dot persists as bullet, spinner, hole, then scales into the white screen of the next scene.

recipe.build: One absolutely positioned circle as a persistent element; at the transition scale it to cover the frame (circle clip-path).

use_when: Any film that must cross worlds without a cut.
avoid: Do not reuse an eye, pupil or slit (house ban); the dot must carry a different meaning each use.
